messages:
Alex W: Thinking out loud — can we add a small ‘token decomp + cache delta’ card to the Cost dashboard that (1) shows per-model token cost, (2) attributes estimated cache savings per-route, and (3) flags routes with >10% variance vs baseline? Want this for the rollout postmortem.
Maria L: +1. curious how we’ll compute 'cache delta' at scale. sampling? full lineage? :thinking_face:
Samir P: We should avoid per-invocation lineage joins in the UI path. Proposal: compute cache savings offline per route daily and expose a sampled live delta in the dashboard for near-real-time. Sampling weight documented.
Alex W: Agreed. UX ask: show sample confidence band on the card and a small CTA to ‘expand for raw samples’. Also need an api to pull the underlying sample rows for the infra team.
Maria L: For the API shape, can we use the existing /v1/costs/summary route and accept a param `sample_mode=live|daily|none`? Returns summary and a `sampled_rows_url` when live.
Samir P: Sounds fine. Watch quotas — live sampling will explode token telemetry. We should gate it behind per-project sampling budgets and a feature flag.
Jules (costbot): auto-report: last 24h token burn: 1.2B tokens, estimated cache savings: 320k tokens (26.7%), top noisy route: /chat/streaming (13% variance). Link: https://infra.internal/snapshots/1748214567
Alex W: Nice. For the backend: data pipeline will emit daily aggregates + a sampled stream with reservoir sampling. Pseudocode for sampling config we discussed:
```
{
  "route": "/chat/streaming",
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "budget_per_project_per_day": 10000,
  "fields": ["prompt_hash","model","route","cache_hit","tokens"]
}
```
Samir P: We'll also need a quota check in the router to decrement the sample budget on each sampled request. If budget exhausted, fallback to `sample_mode=daily`.
Maria L: UX question: how do we surface per-model unit economics? We should show both nominal per-token unit cost and 'amortized' cost when prefetch/pinned cache savings are applied. Maybe an inline toggle: "Show amortized unit cost".
Alex W: Exactly — toggle should re-run the client-side formula using fields returned by the API. Document the formula in the API docs.
Devex Bot: PR opened for API + UI bits: https://git.internal/r/redwood/platform/pulls/812 Add docs stub in /docs/costs/token-decomp.md
Alex W: Next steps: Samir will spike the router-budget check + sampling budget counter. Maria will sketch the card mock and the confidence band. I’ll draft the API contract and add the docs stub. Ping here when PRs are ready. :rocket:
Samir P: Will start tomorrow, will wire a small feature-flag.
Maria L: Mock done by EOD Wednesday, will post screenshot. :thumbsup:
Jules (costbot): reminder: quota metrics will appear in /observability/quotas dashboard once sampling enabled.
Alex W: Great — thanks all.
